# OBIVERSE

> OBIVERSE (Obiverse LLC, home of Kwatasoft) builds systems that stop the leak for Africa's builders: FlowLedger, a stock, sales, debts and bank ledger on the phone and WhatsApp for manufacturers and distributors in Nigeria, which ranks every leak in naira and starts with a ₦100,000 leak diagnostic; and business websites for businesses anywhere, live in 7 days, from ₦400,000 in Nigeria or $1,000 elsewhere. It also makes its own apps: BeeWallet (a self-custody Bitcoin wallet), Obiverse (identity with a Lightning wallet inside), Ngumba (an offline scanner and invoice app) and oSalah (prayer times, Qibla and Quran), on the App Store and Google Play, and for Android from Obiverse Apps, its own store: install once, then every app installs and updates with a tap, each file checked against its signature.

Obiverse LLC. Contact: obiversellc@gmail.com, WhatsApp +1 240 975 0431.

Websites we built that are live: ogaplastic.com (a water tank manufacturer in Nigeria), jawacard.com (a fuel card for drivers in Cameroon) and arteduxcel.com (technology procurement for businesses across Africa). Our own products include 9scroll.com (encrypted memory for AI).

## What we do

- [OBIVERSE](https://obiverse.github.io/): For Africa's builders: we read the records you already keep, show you where the money went and stop the leak. FlowLedger, websites and apps, by Kwatasoft.
- [FlowLedger by Kwatasoft: Stock, Sales & Debts Ledger](https://obiverse.github.io/flowledger.html): The stock, sales, debts and bank ledger for manufacturers and distributors in Nigeria, on your phone and on WhatsApp. Every leak ranked in naira, every night at 9pm.
- [Website Design for Businesses in Nigeria, Live in 7 Days](https://obiverse.github.io/website-design.html): Business websites found on Google and one tap from WhatsApp, built and launched in 7 days: ₦400,000 in Nigeria, $1,000 elsewhere. 60% to start.
- [How Much Does a Website Cost in Nigeria? 2026 Prices](https://obiverse.github.io/website-cost.html): A business website costs ₦400,000 with us, ₦800,000 with online payments, and ₦25,000 a month to run. What that buys, and what to ask before you pay.

## Our work

- [Website for a Water Tank Manufacturer in Nigeria](https://obiverse.github.io/work/ogaplastic.html): The website we built for OGA PLASTIC, a water tank and waste bin maker in Cross River State: products, factory, 23 distributors, quotes on WhatsApp.
- [Bilingual Website for a Fuel Card in Cameroon](https://obiverse.github.io/work/jawacard.html): The website we built for Jawa, a fuel card for drivers in Cameroon: French and English, how the card works, a statement for every fill-up, a member area.
- [Website for a Technology Distributor in Africa](https://obiverse.github.io/work/arteduxcel.html): The website we built for Arteduxcel: U.S. technology sourced for businesses across Africa, four steps from enquiry to delivery, quotes on WhatsApp.

## Apps

- [Obiverse Apps: Our Android Apps, One Tap, Checked](https://obiverse.github.io/apps/): Get BeeWallet, Obiverse, Ngumba and oSalah for Android from one place. Install once; every app then installs and updates with a tap, checked against its signature.
- [BeeWallet: Self-Custody Bitcoin & Lightning Wallet](https://obiverse.github.io/beewallet.html): BeeWallet is a self-custody Bitcoin and Lightning wallet for iPhone and Android: your 12 words, a Mobinumber people can pay, amounts in your own currency.
- [Obiverse App: Bitcoin Lightning Wallet & Nostr Identity](https://obiverse.github.io/app.html): Your keys, your identity, your money. Obiverse is a sovereign Bitcoin Lightning wallet with Nostr identity, built for Africa.
- [Ngumba: Document Scanner & Invoice App](https://obiverse.github.io/ngumba.html): The business centre in your pocket. Scan a page and it comes out straight, clean and small enough to send. Write an invoice in a minute. Everything stays on your phone.
- [oSalah: Prayer Times, Qibla & Quran](https://obiverse.github.io/osalah.html): Your complete Muslim daily companion. Prayer times, Qibla compass, Quran reader, dhikr counter, zakat calculator, and 99 Names of Allah. Offline. No ads.

## Support and policies

- [Obiverse App Support](https://obiverse.github.io/support.html): Get help with the Obiverse app: answers to common questions, troubleshooting steps for wallet and identity, and how to reach the team.
- [oSalah Support](https://obiverse.github.io/osalah-support.html): Get help with oSalah: prayer times, Qibla compass, Quran reader, dhikr counter and more. Answers to common questions and how to contact us.
- [Privacy Policy](https://obiverse.github.io/privacy.html): How OBIVERSE protects your data: your keys, your data, your rules. What the Obiverse app stores, where it lives, and what never leaves your device.
- [Terms of Service](https://obiverse.github.io/terms.html): The terms of service for the OBIVERSE platform and the Obiverse app. Sovereign computing: you hold your keys, and with them the responsibility.
- [Ngumba Privacy Policy](https://obiverse.github.io/ngumba-privacy.html): Ngumba collects nothing. Your documents stay on your phone. There is no account and no server, so there is nothing of yours for anyone to hold.
- [Ngumba Terms of Use](https://obiverse.github.io/ngumba-terms.html): The terms for using Ngumba, the offline scanner and invoice app. It is free, there is no account, and the documents you make are yours.
- [oSalah Privacy Policy](https://obiverse.github.io/osalah-privacy.html): oSalah privacy policy. Your data stays on your device: no account, no tracking, no ads. Location is used only to work out prayer times and the Qibla.
